title: Why Are Unfaithful Chains-of-Thought Longer? A Token-Budget Decomposition

original_idea.body: Segment CoTs into functional units; find which type accounts for excess length in unfaithful CoTs.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: a length-profile feature could become a cheap black-box unfaithfulness monitoring heuristic.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: replicate injection, segment CoTs via classifier/regex; segmentation adds mild effort.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused; CoT segmentation scheme is a contained dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, open models, monitoring-heuristic value, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on 7B model + analysis; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Decomposing the length-gap mechanism appears not directly studied.
